AuthUserDto.description: The authenticated user as exposed to the client.

CartLineRequest.description: One product/quantity line in a cart validation or checkout request.

CustomerDto.description: A customer as returned by the merchant back-office.

CustomerOrderDto.description: One order in a customer's order history.

MerchantDto.description: A shop owned by the caller, as returned by `GET /api/v1/merchants/mine`.

MerchantShopDto.description: Active shop profile and branding as returned by `/merchant/shop`.

OrderDetailDto.description: Full order detail including snapshotted items and status timeline.

OrderItemDto.description: One snapshotted line item of an order.

OrderStatusHistoryDto.description: One append-only audit row of an order's status timeline.

OrderSummaryDto.description: Compact order row used by list endpoints.
